subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers permanently fail closed when patching legacy ownerless session rows, while operator and non-plugin callers retain recovery access?
rationale: The repository establishes exact-owner isolation for plugin-owned rows, but source history does not settle whether pre-ownership rows should be permanently outside plugin authority or migrated through a trusted recovery path.

options.title: Fail closed for plugins
options.body: Reject plugin-runtime patch access to ownerless rows and document operator or doctor recovery as the supported path.

options.title: Define ownership migration
options.body: Add a trusted migration or adoption policy before allowing plugin-runtime patch access to legacy rows.

recommendation.title: Fail closed for plugins
recommendation.body: Reject plugin-runtime patch access to ownerless rows and document operator or doctor recovery as the supported path.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical accessor and existing session ownership boundary trace most directly to his recent Gateway and session-store work.
